selection_protocol: Domain validation correct-supported coverage first, then fewer wrong domain accepts, then source correct-supported coverage/fewer wrong source accepts, then simpler model. Domain accepted error <=5%, domain OOD false acceptance <=5%, source OOD false acceptance <=5%. No observed audit is fitted or used for selection.
historical_audit_policy: Both observed80 sets are retired diagnostics for v3. New final audit must remain hidden until the artifact and threshold are frozen.
